statement: In M2(Z) semidirect SL2(Z), H=SL2(Z) and J=I H I^-1 have trivial discrete intersection and closed product but their profinite intersection is the nontrivial congruence kernel, surjecting onto PSL2(F8).

notes: Four pure marked A5 classes are distinguished by a braid rotation residue. F_5^v fixes one vertex of the first pentagon, contains H_5 with index five, and is isomorphic to F_2.
